project.name: BLADE WebRTC Phone
project.description: Browser softphone for the BLADE WebRTC gateway. A static admin app: it serves the UI and the client library, and every call is negotiated over a WebSocket to the webrtc service on the ENGINE tier. Nothing here talks to SIP or to a media server, so the app has no Java, no framework dependency and no server-side state — the gateway address is configuration, which is what lets the same page be hosted anywhere.
